title: Modules
lead: Finds groups of genes that work together in a tissue network from a pasted gene list, and the functions each group is enriched for.

pairs.caption: The form with the renal disease panel example loaded
pairs.input: Example: renal disease panel (504 genes, kidney)

pairs.caption: Module M1 opened from the modules table

differences.existing: Its own page at /module, with its own title and examples
differences.proposed: On the homepage at /?analysis=modules, chosen from the Analysis picker
differences.evidence: humanbase.io/module; humanbase-frontend.pages.dev/?analysis=modules; ModulesPage.tsx redirects to /?analysis=modules without a body_tag

differences.existing: No size check seen: with 3 genes the Search button stays enabled
differences.proposed: Needs 20 to 3,500 genes; the button is disabled outside that range and a note says why
differences.evidence: Typed BRCA1 TP53 PTEN on humanbase.io/module, Search enabled; ModuleService.ts:22-23, ModuleSearch.tsx:183. Ask Julien what limits the API enforces

differences.existing: Not shown
differences.proposed: Live count under the box (504 genes for the renal panel) and in the button label
differences.evidence: modules-1 captures

differences.existing: Starts on global when you paste your own list; examples set their tissue (kidney)
differences.proposed: No default; you must choose a tissue. Examples set their tissue (Kidney)
differences.evidence: humanbase.io/module with 3 genes showed Select network: global; ModuleSearch.tsx:183 disables the button without a tissue

differences.existing: global is in the network list
differences.proposed: Not offered; only tissue networks are listed
differences.evidence: Existing list includes global; proposed Tissue options had no match for global; ModuleSearch.tsx:63 picks kind tissue only. Ask whether global modules should stay

differences.existing: Pencil button opens an empty title field; examples leave it empty
differences.proposed: Plain Title field, prefilled with the example name
differences.evidence: modules-1 captures; ModuleSearch.tsx:83

differences.existing: Warning lists terms that matched several genes; table with radio buttons to pick one
differences.proposed: Summary (468 matched, 36 to check, none not found) and a table to choose a gene, remove rows or select several
differences.evidence: modules-1 captures; ModuleSearch.tsx:199-205

differences.existing: /module/overview/, /module/detail/ and /module/term/ with body_tag; the open module is not in the URL, so a detail link opens the overview
differences.proposed: /modules/?body_tag=…; open module, tab and filters are kept in the URL (&module=1)

differences.existing: Pencil button beside Title; what it saves is not known

differences.existing: Network select plus a separate submit button

differences.existing: GIANT or MAGE select next to the network

differences.proposed: Terms from: the same four databases
